'''DarthVader,AOE Tatooine Uprising - PLAYERS PRECONSTRUCT 7''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 25 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 LU DarthVader,AOE LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Slightly more bizzare than the usual Player's Preconstruct. The harsh habitat of Tatooine has some even harsher denizens- with surprising abilities. Almost every card in this deck works in a superpowered combo with another.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck has a decent amount of force production and some very powerful characters. The extra sideboard cards and already vast array of combos make this deck more flexible than any of the other Players Preconstructs to date. Should be fun to play.
